purpose: Closing conversion band directly above the footer: an all-caps headline, one line of reassurance and a stacked primary Get started plus outline See Reevo button pair.

variants.name: shared-cta
variants.description: Component CTA.jsx. Takes no props; headline, lede and both buttons are hard-coded. Used on home, pricing, newsletter, compare, integrations, release notes and product pages.

variants.name: mobile-app-cta
variants.description: Page-local copy (MobileCTA) in a file misfiled under blog/. Same layout and same headline and buttons as the shared CTA, but a different lede (app-specific). The lede uses a non-breaking space before its last word. Only on /apps/mobile.

headline.note: Fixed in both implementations. Rendered as h2, uppercase, black-weight heading font.

lede.note: Shared CTA: fixed short sentence (9 words). Mobile-app CTA: page-specific sentence (about 13 words).

behaviour.note: Background is bg-background (white), matching the white footer so no seam shows between them.
Both buttons are full width of a 6-column block (lg) and carry a trailing icon (chevron / video icon).
The two implementations are duplicated code, not one parameterised component; a generator should treat them as one contract with a swappable lede.

motion.reducedMotionNote: Proposal only: no prefers-reduced-motion handling in the code. Only motion is button hover: primary drops to opacity .8, outline gains a tinted background, 200ms.

changes.change: headline spans 6 cols, then 12, then 22, then 21 starting at column 2 at xl
button stack is limited to 6 columns (full width below lg); starts at column 2 at xl
